manifest_summary.approach: Preserved OriginalStrategy.hs: long only when trailing 20- and 40-bar log returns are both positive; otherwise cash. Hold existing long while both remain positive, otherwise sell all held units. Fixed buy units use latest public close, 5bps slippage, 10bps fee and max(12%,4*sigma40) next-close reserve. At least 41 closes required, so anonymous 60-bar history suffices; no calendars, real prices or volume signal. Reserve reduces but cannot eliminate unknown-next-close infeasibility. No verified predictive superiority claimed.
manifest_summary.changes: Selected original agent-one trend heuristic rather than unproven transfer. Signal and sizing unchanged from authorized preserved OriginalStrategy.hs; added public-input checks, structured manifests, exact sell serialization and submission readback validation in isolated competition source. StrategyV1 consensus needs 121 bars and is incompatible. Agent-two experiment hypothesis-and-policy.json identifies weekly calendar-dependent cadence, 200-bar filter and different fill-price sizing: none transplanted. Round 0. Feedback: No previous settlement evidence. Original retained without performance claims.

manifest_summary.approach: Preserve OwnGeneralized dual-horizon momentum: when flat buy only if both 10-bar and 20-bar close returns are positive; when invested sell all only if close is below its 20-bar mean and 10-bar return is negative; otherwise hold. Entry spends at most 90% of decision-close cash including 5bp slippage and 10bp fee, units rounded down to 8 decimals. Uses only anonymous public closes, at least 41 bars, and supplied own account. No calendar, volume signal, long warmup or peer decisions. Unknown next-close buy feasibility cannot be guaranteed: reserve accommodates an approximately 11.11% rise, not larger. Sales use supplied held units; header-only holds require no fill.
